principle: Patterns encode the LUMENIS narrative: Context → Facts → Relationships → Evidence → Finding → Risk → Decision → Action → Outcome → Trace → Provenance. A pattern is a spatial/interaction grammar, never a flowchart drawing.

shared_contract.truth_rule: missing data renders UNKNOWN/N-A, never 0; DESIGN_ONLY data carries data-source=prototype

patterns.name: Context / Selected Subject
patterns.rule: Selected Subject persists across drill-down (Return 归点）；≤768 becomes drawer.

patterns.name: Facts / Metric Field Row
patterns.rule: one dominant number per group; hairline boundary; number big unit small.

patterns.name: Relationships / Event Graph
patterns.rule: monochrome edges, icy only on selected trace; no decorative force-layout.

patterns.name: Evidence Trace
patterns.rule: Claim→Evidence→Source; selected = 1px icy path; every claim cites; mono EV ids.

patterns.name: Finding / Editorial Insight
patterns.rule: insight in display serif between hairlines; no lorem, concrete numbers.

patterns.name: Risk Assessment
patterns.rule: no colored side bar; color+icon+label triple-encoded.

patterns.name: Decision / Options
patterns.rule: show confidence AND limitation; never hide uncertainty; one primary choice.

patterns.name: Action / Approval
patterns.rule: EFFECT requires confirm showing scope/target/permission; no fake success.

patterns.name: Outcome / Result
patterns.rule: link outcome back to evidence and actor.

patterns.name: Trace / Timeline
patterns.rule: vertical axis whispers; events are points; grouping by proximity.

patterns.name: Provenance / Lineage
patterns.rule: separate capture/publish time; UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN.

patterns.name: Native AI Workspace
patterns.rule: conversation + evidence + workspace + action; expose state not private reasoning.

patterns.name: State Surfaces
patterns.rule: distinct copy/visual per state; never collapse to 0; helpful single next action.

anti_patterns_forbidden: side color bar on rounded card
fake 200 / mock fallback presented as live
